title: Bug: [upgrade_path] critical_services_fully_started failure after boot_into_base_image because old critical_services_tracking_list is used
author: markx-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

After we recently enabled bmp on 202605, test_upgrade_path failed critical_services_fully_started check after boot_into_base_image which boots into 202511 image.
We found that critical_services_tracking_list() builds the service list from self.facts['features'], which is cached at pytest session start and never refreshed. After booting into a different image, the cached feature table still reflects the original image, so services absent from the base image remain in the tracking list. The check then waits indefinitely for containers that will never start.

### Steps to Reproduce

Enable bmp on new image, then run test_upgrade_path on base image without bmp enabled.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Critical service check should be based on running config instead of cached value from when the pytest session start.

comments.author: markx-arista
comments.body:
This is caused by https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/21442, which replaced config_facts with self.facts.
This PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/18136 added critical_services_tracking_list in reboot(), which correctly resets the critical service list after reboot.
Reverting https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/21442 can fix the issue.
@wangxin @Ryangwaite FYI

comments.author: Ryangwaite
comments.body: Hi @markx-arista, I don't think we should revert PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/21442 to fix this. That PR is a performance improvement benefitting the majority of the test suite and it is reasonable that cache invalidation is required following a sonic version change during the test. We have a few sign posted [places](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/fixtures/advanced_reboot.py#L661) by call to `self.duthost.meta("clear_facts")` where that should be done. Ideally, we would add a new `SonicHost.refresh_facts()` which blows away the entire cache and refetches it and call it at those sites. That is a bugfix + enhancement though. You may wish to do that or something similar otherwise the pure bugfix in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/26167 lgtm.

comments.author: markx-arista
comments.body:
> Hi [@markx-arista](https://github.com/markx-arista), I don't think we should revert PR [#21442](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/21442) to fix this. That PR is a performance improvement benefitting the majority of the test suite and it is reasonable that cache invalidation is required following a sonic version change during the test. We have a few sign posted [places](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/fixtures/advanced_reboot.py#L661) by call to `self.duthost.meta("clear_facts")` where that should be done. Ideally, we would add a new `SonicHost.refresh_facts()` which blows away the entire cache and refetches it and call it at those sites. That is a bugfix + enhancement though. You may wish to do that or something similar otherwise the pure bugfix in [#26167](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/26167) lgtm.

Thanks for the reply. I closed #26167 because we just found that it caused a regression in test_mgmt_ipv6_only.py. The test switches mgmt IP from v4 to v6 and runs duthost.reset() in the middle, which calls `critical_services_tracking_list` including the newly added `show feature status` command, but it still uses old v4 mgmt IP to run the command and so it caused a bad file descriptor error.

I agree that we should refresh the facts during upgrade test, and probably config reload as well? I will take a look.

By the way, duthost.meta("clear_facts") is already called during `boot_into_base_image` in [reboot() ](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/reboot.py#L438), but I think it only clears Ansible’s fact cache, not the facts stored in `SonicHost`.

comments.author: markx-arista
comments.body:
> Hi [@markx-arista](https://github.com/markx-arista), I don't think we should revert PR [#21442](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/21442) to fix this. That PR is a performance improvement benefitting the majority of the test suite and it is reasonable that cache invalidation is required following a sonic version change during the test. We have a few sign posted [places](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/fixtures/advanced_reboot.py#L661) by call to `self.duthost.meta("clear_facts")` where that should be done. Ideally, we would add a new `SonicHost.refresh_facts()` which blows away the entire cache and refetches it and call it at those sites. That is a bugfix + enhancement though. You may wish to do that or something similar otherwise the pure bugfix in [#26167](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/26167) lgtm.

I did a partial revert of #21442 in critical_services_tracking_list:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/26372

It restores config_facts in `critical_services_tracking_list`. The function is called when `MultiAsicSonicHost` is first constructed or during config_reload/reboot to update critical service list, so I believe it should query the live features instead of the one cached in facts.

However,  like my previous PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/26167, it still leads to failure in `test_mgmt_ipv6_only.py`. Using config_facts in `critical_services_tracking_list` had no issue on 202511, but it has issue on 202605 due to new ansible version. We will have another PR to fix that.

Summary:
After boot_into_base_image, critical_services_fully_started fails because services like bmp that exist on the original image but not on the base image remain in the list.
#21442 changed critical_services_tracking_list to read feature state from self.facts, which is gathered once at init time. This causes stale feature data after reboot/upgrade/config reload, breaking critical service checks. Revert to querying config_facts live each time.
For newer Ansible, reset only the connection in test_mgmt_ipv6_only.py to prevent config_facts from reusing a stale IPv4 connection.

Fixes #26166
